summary: The choosers module facilitates the selection of items between two lists using JavaScript functions to manipulate and transfer selected items. It employs client-side scripting for item movement and updates and includes controls for automated field updates.
purpose: To manage item selection and transfer between lists, enabling dynamic updates of included and excluded items.

workflows.name: Item Selection Workflow
steps: User selects items in source list.
JavaScript moves selected items to destination list.
Hidden field is updated to reflect changes.

system_behavior: JavaScript functions handle item movement and list updates.
Controls are enabled or disabled based on conditions.
